generic.Defined scope/population: All vendor banking detail changes submitted through the ERP vendor master this period
generic.In-scope period: Changes submitted since the last banking-change review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bank account, routing number, maker ID and checker ID populated on every change
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of pending banking changes matches count routed to the checker queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Maker entry, checker approval, and callback verification timestamped in the change log
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any change with a matching maker and checker ID logged and blocked before posting
generic.Test population: Sample of vendor banking changes posted to the ERP vendor master this period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of banking changes show a distinct maker and checker ID with verification evidence
generic.Exception handling path: Change with same maker/checker ID or failed callback escalated to Vendor Manager before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Change is dual-approved by different users and verified via callback, not the request form
generic.Evidence location: Vendor master change log and attached callback record in the ERP vendor folder

steps.title: Enter the proposed banking change as a pending edit in the ERP vendor master Banking Details tab
sop: Open the vendor master record in the ERP and select the Banking Details tab.
Enter the new bank account and routing number as a pending edit, not a live update.
Save the pending edit so it routes to the maker-checker workflow queue.
Done when the pending banking edit appears in the checker queue.
verify: Confirm the vendor master still shows the prior banking details as active.
Pass when the change sits in pending status and has not posted live.

steps.title: Verify the new bank account via callback to a verified vendor phone number
sop: Pull the verified vendor phone number from the original W-9 or remittance letter on file.
Call that number, not the number on the change request, to confirm the new account.
Record the callback date, contact name and outcome in the vendor master change log.
Done when the callback confirms the new account details match the request.
verify: Compare the callback record against the phone number on the original W-9/remittance letter.
Pass when the callback used the on-file number, not the number on the change request.

steps.title: Route the pending banking change to a second approver in the maker-checker queue
sop: Submit the pending edit into the ERP maker-checker approval queue.
Confirm the queue assigns a checker different from the maker user ID.
Done when the change is queued with a distinct checker assigned.
verify: Check the workflow queue log for the maker and checker user IDs.
Pass when maker and checker are two different system user IDs.

steps.title: Confirm the checker is not the same user ID as the maker before approving
sop: Open the queued banking change in the maker-checker workflow.
Confirm the system blocks self-approval by matching maker and checker IDs.
Reject and re-route any change where the checker matches the maker.
Done when the system-enforced control confirms distinct users.
verify: Review the workflow control log for the same-user-ID check result.
Pass when the control log shows no same-user-ID approval occurred.

steps.title: Approve the verified banking change in the ERP checker step
sop: Review the callback verification evidence attached to the pending change.
Approve the change in the checker step of the ERP workflow.
Done when the banking change posts live to the vendor master.
verify: Confirm the vendor master now shows the new bank account as active.
Pass when the posted change matches the verified callback details exactly.

steps.title: Record the dual-approval timestamp and approver names in the change log
sop: Open the vendor master change log after the change posts.
Enter the maker name and timestamp, then the checker name and timestamp.
Done when both approval timestamps are logged against the change record.
verify: Pull the change log entry for the posted banking change.
Pass when maker and checker timestamps are both present and distinct.

steps.title: Sample recent banking changes to confirm no same-user maker-checker approvals
sop: Pull the vendor master banking-change history for the review period.
Compare maker and checker IDs on each change for a match.
Done when the sample confirms no same-user approvals in the period.
verify: Cross-check any flagged match against the escalation log.
Pass when every sampled change shows a distinct maker and checker ID.

generic.Defined scope/population: All vendors onboarded and closed out in the current onboarding cycle

steps.title: Upload the W-9, COI and sanctions screening result into the same vendor folder

verify: Search the repository by vendor ID to confirm the tag returns the correct folder.
Pass when vendor ID, date and risk tier all display correctly.

steps.title: Apply the document retention schedule and legal-hold flag in SharePoint
sop: Open the folder's retention settings in Microsoft 365/SharePoint.

Attach the onboarding summary document to the draft confirmation.

steps.title: Send the sponsor notification through the procurement system's notification workflow
sop: Send the notice via the Coupa/Ariba notification workflow to the named sponsor.
Confirm the workflow logs a sent timestamp.
Done when the sponsor notification is sent and logged.
verify: Open the notification history for the case.

steps.title: Confirm sponsor receipt and close the onboarding case
sop: Check for a delivery or read receipt on the sent notification.
Update the onboarding case status to Complete once confirmed.
Done when the case is closed with confirmation on file.
verify: Review the case record for the Complete status and receipt evidence.
Pass when the case is closed with a confirmed sponsor notification.

steps.title: Log the sponsor confirmation send in the onboarding case history
sop: Open the onboarding case record after the notification is sent.
Attach a copy of the sent confirmation to the case history.

verify: Open the case history to confirm the attachment.

generic.Defined scope/population: All high-volume suppliers subject to annual vendor statement reconciliation

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Statement reconciled to the ERP open-item balance with variance explained or cleared
generic.Evidence location: BlackLine reconciliation record with the supplier statement attached

steps.title: Pull the vendor statement for each high-volume supplier from the vendor portal or email
sop: Collect the current-period vendor statement for each high-volume supplier.
Save each statement to the reconciliation working folder.
Done when a statement is on hand for every high-volume supplier.
verify: Cross-check the supplier list against the high-volume supplier list.
Pass when a statement is collected for every supplier on the list.

steps.title: Match the vendor statement to the open-item balance in the ERP AP subledger
sop: Pull the open-item balance for the supplier from the ERP AP subledger.
Compare the statement balance line-by-line against the open items.
Done when each statement line is matched or flagged as a difference.
verify: Re-total the matched lines and compare to the ERP subledger total.
Pass when the matched total ties to the ERP open-item balance within threshold.

steps.title: Investigate and clear items over the reconciling-item threshold

Contact Procurement or the vendor to resolve each item.
Clear or document the resolution for each investigated item.
Done when every item over threshold is cleared or documented.
verify: Review the resolution note for each investigated item.
Pass when no item over threshold remains unresolved without documentation.

steps.title: Document the reconciliation in BlackLine with the supporting statement attached
sop: Open the reconciliation template in BlackLine for the supplier.
Attach the vendor statement and the resolution notes.
Done when the BlackLine reconciliation is saved with attachments.
verify: Open the BlackLine record and confirm the statement attachment is present.
Pass when the reconciliation and attachment are both saved in BlackLine.

steps.title: Obtain Controller sign-off for any unreconciled variance above materiality
sop: Summarize any remaining variance above the materiality threshold.
Route the summary to the Controller for review and sign-off.
Done when the Controller's sign-off is recorded in BlackLine.
verify: Check the BlackLine approval trail for the Controller's sign-off.
Pass when variance above materiality is signed off or the reconciliation is fully cleared.

steps.title: Close the annual reconciliation cycle for the supplier in BlackLine
sop: Mark the reconciliation task complete in BlackLine.
Confirm the completion date is logged against the reconciliation period.
Done when the task status shows Complete for the reporting period.
verify: Pull the BlackLine task list for the period.
Pass when every high-volume supplier reconciliation shows Complete status.

steps.title: Route the new vendor master record for Procurement Manager approval
sop: Submit the vendor master record into the ERP approval workflow.

steps.title: Approve the vendor master record and set it to active status
sop: Review the duplicate-check result, terms and attached documentation.
Approve the record in the ERP workflow.
Confirm the vendor status changes to Active.

steps.title: Confirm the duplicate-check result is attached to the vendor master before routing for approval
sop: Open the vendor master record.
Confirm the duplicate-check report is attached as supporting evidence.
Done when the duplicate-check report is attached to the record.
verify: Review the attachment list on the vendor master.

steps.title: Set flagged accounts to inactive status in the ERP vendor master

steps.title: Record the deactivation reason and date in the vendor master change log
sop: Open the change log for each deactivated vendor.
